text: What happens when two threads call queue.add() simultaneously on an unprotected queue? The list append might interleave, corrupting internal state. This is a race condition.
What is threading.Lock? It provides mutual exclusion only one thread can hold it at a time. Any thread trying to acquire it while it's held will block until it's released.
How do you use a lock safely? The 'with lock:' statement acquires the lock on entry and releases it on exit, even if an exception occurs. This is the critical section pattern.
What are the four conditions for deadlock? (1) Mutual exclusion, (2) Hold and wait, (3) No preemption, (4) Circular wait. To prevent deadlock, break any one condition.
If thread 1 acquires lock A then lock B, and thread 2 acquires lock B then lock A, you have circular wait. How do you prevent this? Always acquire locks in the same order across all threads.
What is a Semaphore? It allows N threads to access a resource simultaneously. threading.Semaphore(N) is like N identical locks. Useful for connection pools.
What is queue.Queue? A thread-safe queue that handles all synchronization internally. Unlike manually locking a list, Queue blocks on get() when empty and handles all edge cases.
The traffic jam emerges when individual threads (cars) don't coordinate. The lock (traffic light) enforces order. With too many locks (gridlock) or no locks (collision), chaos ensues.
